card.statement:
<<cite:EK>>
Let $\ga =\gl_N$ or $\sgl_N$, and let $\la$ be a partition of $N$.
There exists a one-to-one correspondence between the set of
pyramids of shape $\la$ and the set of good $\Z$-gradings for a
nilpotent matrix of Jordan shape $\la$ up to $GL_N$-conjugation,

$$
\{\text{Pyramids of shape } \la\}  \longrightarrow \{\text{good
}\Z\text{-gradings for a nilpotent matrix in }\mc O_\la\}/GL_N
$$

by sending $P$ to $\Gamma^P$.
card.label: Theorem 40

paper.title: Nilpotent orbits and finite $W$-algebras
paper.abstract: In recent years, the finite W-algebras associated to a semisimple Lie algebra and its nilpotent element have been studied intensively from different viewpoints. In this lecture series, we shall present some basic constructions, connections, and applications of finite W-algebras.
